$description: Classes going away (VERSIONING.md, Deprecation; issue 882). They keep working until they are removed, no earlier than the next minor release, with one exception: the classes listed under `until` are promised until that version (the 0.84 changelog) and are not removed before it. Check-style fails on a new use of any listed class (rule deprecated-classes). The tokens going away carry $deprecated in their token file instead. The 308 classes listed here before the release after 0.90.0 were removed in #723 (issue 125), and the eight CTM used until CTM#144 in #735; both lists are in the changelog's Removed section.
